plugins.name: vibetalk
plugins.description: VibeTalk — hands-free vibe-coding by voice: background mic listener (local STT), spoken replies (local TTS), barge-in, floating panel with per-language speakers. Drives Claude Desktop by voice too: new session, palette, stop, dictation, switching between sessions and handing the voice over (Linux/X11). RU/UK/EN auto-detection.
